title: quest doctor should report a leftover .write.lock with no live holder (question and task stores)
description:
FILE AND HOLD -- do not build until team-lead says so.

The question store (like the task store) serializes writes with a mkdir-based lock directory (.quest/questions/.write.lock; the task store uses its own). A process killed between acquiring the lock and its finally-rm leaves the lock behind, and every later write then fails with a store conflict (exit 5) with nothing naming the cause. Today `quest doctor` reports nothing about it.

quest doctor should report a leftover lock directory that has no live holder (no live journal/session behind it), for BOTH the question store and the task store, with the removal path in the hint so an operator can clear it. Reported by the DEC-183 round-2 reviewer on QCLI-445; filed, not built.
